note: Single source of truth for every output format the resizer supports. docs/FORMAT-CATALOG.md is generated from this file by scripts/gen-catalog.mjs — edit this file, never the markdown. Every placement carries verifiedOn + docs so drift is auditable; platform specs change without notice and any entry older than 90 days is surfaced as stale in the admin UI.

units.canvas: pixels, the render target the pipeline outputs at 1x
units.safeZone: pixels inset from each edge of the stated canvas; no text, logo, or CTA may enter this band
units.maxBytes: hard platform limit; the encoder targets 90% of this
units.loudnessLufs: integrated program loudness target for the mixed audio track
units.context: Viewing context that selects the legibility floors in data/legibility.json. Platform-level value applies unless the placement overrides it.

placements.name: Feed — Square
notes: Highest-volume placement; treat as the primary master when the brief does not say otherwise.
Feed crops nothing, but the caption block sits below — do not duplicate caption copy in-image.

placements.name: Feed — Portrait
notes: Tallest ratio the feed will render without centre-cropping; wins the most screen height on mobile.

placements.name: Stories
notes: Profile row and progress bar occupy the top band; the CTA sticker and 'Sponsored' label occupy the bottom band.
Background must reach all four edges — the platform does not letterbox, it stretches or bars.

placements.name: Reels
notes: Most aggressive chrome of any placement: caption, profile, audio ticker and CTA all overlay the frame.
The right-edge inset covers the like/comment/share rail — a logo lockup placed bottom-right will be obscured.

placements.name: In-Stream Video
notes: Skip control and countdown sit in the lower band. Sound-on placement — mix for audible playback.

placements.name: Right Column
notes: Renders as small as 254px wide. Any type below the display legibility floor must be dropped, not shrunk.

placements.name: Carousel Card
notes: All cards in a set must share ratio and canvas; the batch validator enforces set consistency.

platforms.name: Google Display Network — Uploaded Display Ads (IAB)

notes: 150 KB ceiling applies to every size including animated GIF and HTML5 bundles.
Border required: ads on a white background need a visible 1px frame.

placements.name: Medium Rectangle
notes: Highest-inventory display size.

placements.name: Leaderboard
notes: Headline-only size; body copy is dropped by the type rules.

placements.name: Button
notes: Logo-only size — the layout solver drops all copy.

placements.name: Mobile Leaderboard
notes: Smallest supported canvas; logo + 1 short headline only.

platforms.name: Google Ads — Responsive Asset Sets (RDA, Performance Max, Demand Gen)

placements.name: Marketing Image — Landscape
notes: Required asset. Google crops up to 5% from each edge on some surfaces — keep a 5% content inset.

placements.name: Marketing Image — Square
notes: Required asset.

placements.name: Logo — Square
notes: Transparent PNG preferred. Rendered circular on some surfaces — keep the mark inside an inscribed circle.

placements.name: Video — Vertical
notes: Serves into Shorts and Discover — same chrome problem as Reels.

placements.name: In-Stream (skippable & non-skippable)
notes: Non-skippable capped at 15–20s by market. Skip button and progress bar sit in the lower band.

placements.name: Bumper
notes: 6s hard cap — the duration adapter must land a legible end-card inside 6s.

placements.name: Masthead
notes: Autoplays muted — must read without sound.

placements.name: In-Feed — Vertical
notes: The published safe area is the tightest in market — the bottom band carries the caption, handle, music ticker and CTA.
Sound-on by default; captions still required for comprehension.

placements.name: In-Feed — Landscape
notes: Pillarboxed in a vertical feed — deprioritise unless the buy is Pangle.

placements.name: Brand Logo
notes: Rendered circular — keep the mark inside an inscribed circle.

placements.name: Single Image or Video Ad
notes: 32 MB ceiling on video is the binding constraint — the encoder drops to a lower bitrate ladder rung here.

placements.name: Standard Pin
notes: 2:3 is the only ratio the feed renders uncropped at full height.

placements.name: Max-Width Video Pin
notes: Spans the full feed width with copy rendered below — no in-image caption needed.

placements.name: Single Image — Portrait
notes: Mobile-only surface.

placements.name: Video — Landscape
notes: Minimum file size 75 KB — the encoder floor prevents over-compression on flat graphics.

placements.name: Spotlight / Text Ad Logo
notes: Also served at 100x100 and 50x50 — logo-only, no type.

placements.name: Sponsored Display — Custom Image
notes: No text, logos, or CTAs permitted in the custom image — the validator hard-fails any detected type.

placements.name: Sponsored Brands Video
notes: Audio target is quieter than social; -19 LUFS integrated, true peak -2 dBTP.

platforms.name: CTV / OTT (DV360, Roku, Amazon, Hulu, Netflix Ads)

placements.name: CTV — 1080p
notes: Title-safe inset follows broadcast convention (5% of each edge) — living-room viewing distance and TV overscan both bite.
Loudness is broadcast spec (-24 LKFS ±2, true peak -2 dBTP), roughly 10 dB quieter than social.
Minimum legible type is far larger than mobile: 2% of frame height.

placements.name: Audio Companion Banner
notes: Rendered as small as 300x300 — logo plus one short line.

placements.name: Urban Panel — Portrait

notes: Silent playback — no audio track.
Viewed at 2–5 m: minimum type is 3% of frame height, and no more than 7 words on screen at once.

placements.name: Digital Billboard — 2:1
notes: Viewed at 30 m+: headline only, minimum type 6% of frame height.

placements.name: Email Hero (2x retina)
notes: Renders at 600 CSS px — legibility is computed against the 600px display width, not the 1200px canvas.
